title: Probable Treatment Targets for Diabetic Retinopathy Based on an Integrated Proteomic and Genomic Analysis
body:
##  [ Probable Treatment Targets for Diabetic Retinopathy Based on an Integrated Proteomic and Genomic Analysis ](</content/reactome-research-spotlight/190-probable-treatment-targets-for-diabetic-retinopathy-based-on-an-integrated-proteomic-and-genomic-analysis>)

Analysis of all constituents of entire Reactome pathways identified by the presence of upregulated or mutated genes helped [Valdivia et al. in the February, 2023 issue of Translational Vision Science & Technology](<https://tvst.arvojournals.org/article.aspx?articleid=2785339>) to identify druggable targets and potential drugs for the treatment of diabetic retinopathy (DR). Drugs affecting MMP13 and LGALS3 in the regulation of myeloid cell differentiation by RUNX2 were notable candidates.
